Theorem
[Three-dimensional $\kappa $-gap] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0138, page-0139, page-0140 ↗ thm:chow-iii-asymptotic-shrinker ↗ thm:chow-iii-no-3d-shrinker ↗ thm:chow-iii-weakened-no-local-collapsing ↗ lem:chow-iii-large-neighborhood-estimates 1. ch19:19.56\group $\kappa $-Gap

There is a universal $\kappa _0>0$ such that every three-dimensional nonspherical space-form $\kappa $-solution is $\kappa _0$-noncollapsed at all scales. Its asymptotic shrinker is the round cylinder $S^2\times \mathbb R$ or its $\mathbb Z_2$ quotient; a positive lower bound for the reduced volume rules out collapse by the weakened no-local-collapsing estimate.
